review.why: Extracts Reddit posts and nested comments for a keyword through an API script, for competitor and sentiment research.
review.summary: Runs a bundled Python script against the BrowserAct API to collect Reddit posts and comments by keyword, date range and sort order, with a comments-per-post limit. It lists the output fields (title, subreddit, votes, comment text, author, nesting) and gives retry rules and background-execution settings for long runs.
strengths: Parameters for date range, post sort, comment sort and limits
Output includes nesting level and reply links for thread analysis
Defined retry rule: no retry on an invalid key, one retry otherwise
cautions: Collects commenter usernames and profile links: needs a privacy review
Needs the BrowserAct service and key; runs take 5 to 20 minutes
Includes setup instructions for one specific agent runner
